description: GNN flyvis_conductance (g_phi = MLP(a_i,a_j,v_i,v_j)) trained with model noise sigma 0.05, evaluated by 5-fold CV (mean ± SD) on 7,207-7,999 held-out frames per fold. Rows cover: low model noise (group lasso 25/100); measurement noise with 20-step recurrent training; unknown stimulus (SIREN, scored on first 7,999 training frames); null_edges_pc_400; removed_pc_20/50 with hid10; 1/5 frames observed at horizons s5h06/s5h21; hid20.
facts:
CAPTION: GNN evaluation across degraded Flyvis-217; model noise σ = 0.05, 5-fold CV (mean ± SD) with variable measurement noise (γ), unknown stimulus, added/removed edges, sub- sampled frames, and hidden neurons. Every row is the general-form GNN (gϕ = MLP(ai, aj, vi, vj), group lasso 25; group lasso 100 where the row says so) of the campaign: experiments 2 (low model noise), 3 (measurement noise, trained with the 20-step recurrent rollout since one-step training was not run for this form), 11 (unknown stimulus), 4 (null edges, group lasso 25 and 100; bf16 matrix products in the two MLPs, fp32 elsewhere), 14 (edges removed, 10% hidden), 5 (1/5 frames, the rollout scored on the observed frames only, horizons 6 and 21) and 9 (20% hidden). FACTS:
- low model noise: experiment 2: GNN MLP(ai,aj,vi,vj), group lasso, model noise
- measurement noise: experiment 3: Measurement noise: 20-step recurrent training
- unknown stimulus: experiment 11: Unknown visual stimulus (SIREN)
- +400% null edges: experiment 4: +400% null edges
- edges removed: experiment 14: Edges removed (-20%, -50%) and 10% hidden neurons
- 1/5 frames: experiment 5: 1/5 frames observed
- 10% hidden: experiment 14: Edges removed (-20%, -50%) and 10% hidden neurons
- 20% hidden: experiment 9: 20% hidden neurons
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
